beatOutlines.textOutline: Raju took a trade on Kesar Paints with an arbitrary target of ₹150.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Sharma ji asked what mathematical basis justified that ₹200 target.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Raju asked if Fibonacci ratios truly govern wave magnitude and time.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Raju went long at ₹150, but Wave 2 correction took hold immediately.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: The stock plunged 61.8% and halted precisely at the ₹119 Golden Ratio floor.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Trading without ratios is shooting in the dark; Fibonacci illuminates turning points.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: According to John Murphy, Fibonacci numbers form the mathematical foundation of Elliott Wave.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: We will see how Fibonacci ratios govern wave retracements and impulse expansions.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: And finally, we will unite Pattern, Ratio, and Time to identify high-probability setups.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Thirteenth-century mathematician Fibonacci revealed a sequence underlying nature and markets alike.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: In Elliott Wave theory, total wave counts always resolve to Fibonacci numbers.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: During corrective phases, three key Fibonacci levels provide formidable market support.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Wave 4 typically terminates at 38.2%, reflecting vigorous underlying trend momentum.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Meanwhile, Wave 2 often dives deeply toward 61.8% to thoroughly test committed buyers.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Wave 3 is usually the longest, extending at least 1.618 times the length of Wave 1.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: In ultra-bullish runaway markets, Wave 3 can stretch to an extended 2.618 multiple.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: When Wave 3 is extended, Wave 5 frequently equals the exact amplitude of Wave 1.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Fibonacci forecasts not only price displacement, but also indicates when turning points arrive.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: When 21, 34, or 55 periods elapse from a major pivot, trend reversal odds spike dramatically.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: When price and time converge simultaneously, the market carves its most potent turning point.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

scenes.title: The Trinity: Pattern, Ratio, and Time
scenes.concept: The Trinity: Pattern, Ratio, and Time

beatOutlines.textOutline: Under Elliott Wave, three elements dominate: Pattern ranks first, followed by Ratio, then Time.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: If the 5-wave pattern is incomplete, trading solely on a Fibonacci level can trigger severe traps.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Yet when 5 waves complete at 61.8% ratio exactly on a Fibonacci time bar, success probability peaks.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

takeaways: The Trinity: Pattern, Ratio, and Time

beatOutlines.textOutline: Notice on Kesar Paints: Wave 2 formed a hammer right at 61.8% on the 21st Fibonacci day.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: With triple confirmation in place, an explosive Wave 3 launch got underway.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Murphy's rule: when Pattern, Ratio, and Time align, risk is minimized and reward is maximized.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Now your turn. Correctly evaluate this Elliott Wave and Fibonacci scenario.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Think... what is the Fibonacci formula for a standard Wave 3 extension?
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: ₹200! Wave 3 equals 1.618 times Wave 1 (₹81), added to the Wave 2 floor of ₹119, reaching ₹200.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Raju noted the harmony between Fibonacci and Elliott Wave in his trading journal.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Sharma ji explained the ultimate practical trading rule of the Trinity.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: The entire Elliott Wave architecture is mathematically grounded in Fibonacci.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: The Golden Ratio 1.618 and reciprocal 0.618 govern market geometry.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Wave 4 retests near 38.2%, while Wave 2 retraces deeply toward 61.8%.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Wave 3 targets a 1.618 extension, while Wave 5 seeks equality with Wave 1.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Fibonacci Time Targets flag turn dates, creating the ultimate confluence signal.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Remember: Pattern provides structure, Ratio sets levels, and Time selects the precise execution moment.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

summarySteps: Elliott Wave is built entirely on the Fibonacci sequence (8, 34, 144 waves)
Golden Ratio 1.618 and its inverse 0.618 govern market geometry
50% retracement acts as standard Dow and Gann equilibrium balance
Wave 3 projects to a minimum of 1.618 times Wave 1 length
Wave 5 tends toward equality with Wave 1 when Wave 3 extends
Fibonacci Time Targets count pivot bars (13, 21, 34, 55) for turn dates
The Trinity: Pattern is primary, Ratio sets levels, Time times the trigger
bottomTakeaway: Discipline and grounded market understanding are essential for survival.
